title: Compound light microscope
use: Microscope picture (parts of a microscope, life science)
notes: Side view, no labels: eyepiece, body tube, revolving nosepiece with 3 objectives (red, yellow, blue bands), stage with 2 clips holding a slide, condenser, lamp in the base, arm, coarse (large) and fine (small) focus knobs, base.

title: Onion skin cells under a microscope
use: Plant cells picture (cell wall, nucleus; plant vs animal cells)
notes: Circular field of view on a dark surround. Brick-like rectangular cells in staggered rows, thick brown cell walls, one nucleus per cell, iodine stain pale yellow-brown. Drawn from general knowledge of the classroom slide.

title: Cheek cells under a microscope
use: Animal cells picture (cell membrane, nucleus; plant vs animal cells)
notes: Circular field of view. Flat irregular polygonal cells with thin membranes (no walls), methylene blue stain, darker blue nucleus in each, a few cells overlapping, small specks in the background. Drawn from general knowledge of the classroom slide.

title: Bacteria under a microscope
use: Bacteria picture (single-celled organisms, shapes of bacteria)
notes: Circular field of view. Pink rod-shaped bacteria (bacilli, one chain of three) and purple round bacteria (cocci): three chains and one grape-like cluster, plus scattered single cells.

title: Green leaf
notes: A simple oval leaf with a pointed tip, petiole, midrib, and secondary veins that branch off the midrib toward the tip, with small veinlets.

title: Bird feather
use: Feather picture (animal body coverings, structure and function)
notes: A contour feather: hollow shaft (rachis) running to the tip, two vanes (the upper one wider) with barbs drawn as fine lines slanting toward the tip, two small splits in the vanes, and a fluffy downy base near the quill.
